findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#question-person" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to the destination vars of each future fromTo, or set a safe resting state with an earlier `tl.set("#question-person", { ... }, 0)`. Pre-first-tween seeks must not inherit whichever fromTo call happened to author last.
